descriptionFull: The Eurasian bittern or great bittern ( Botaurus stellaris ) is a wading bird in the bittern subfamily (Botaurinae) of the heron family Ardeidae. There are two subspecies, the northern race ( B. s. stellaris ) breeding in parts of Europe and Asia, as well as on the northern coast of Africa, while the southern race ( B. s. capensis ) is endemic to parts of southern Africa.
